roads.name: Coomb's Cove Road
words: Sweeping and steady: 8 curves in 2.8 miles.
From 19 to 182 ft, with 563 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 90 km/h limit its corners still ask for about 0.92 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.

roads.name: Main Street
words: Properly twisty: 15 curves in 2.6 miles, about 6 a mile.
From 0 to 121 ft, with 481 ft of up and down along the way.
Homes line much of it: about 47 buildings a mile beside the road.
